name: business-funding
offer: business funding or a business loan
offer_context: Small business funding: loans, lines of credit, equipment financing and working capital. Buyers are owners who need money for their business.

brief.offer: Small business funding: term loans, lines of credit, equipment financing and working capital.
brief.buyer_profile: Small business owners who say they need working capital, a loan or financing, or ask where to get funding after a bank said no.
need_statements: Where can I get funding for my small business?
Need working capital to cover payroll.
Got denied by the bank, what are my options?
How do I get a line of credit for my LLC?
high_examples: My bank turned down our loan. Can anyone recommend a lender for a small business with two years of revenue?
Need about $50k in working capital for inventory. Who have you used?
Looking for equipment financing for a second truck. Any good lenders?
medium_examples: Is an SBA loan worth the wait or should I look at alternative lenders?
Cash flow is tight this quarter. How do other owners bridge the gap?
What credit score do you need for a business line of credit?
low_examples: We just paid off our SBA loan!
Here is how I bootstrapped my business without funding.
Interest rates are wild right now.
